svg.title: P020 · Days to ship and days to deliver
svg.desc: One row per November 2025 order. Order 3 was placed in October even though it shipped in November. Orders 1 and 2 qualify. For order 1, November 3 minus 1 = 2 days to ship and November 6 minus 1 = 5 to deliver. Order 2 keeps two NULLs. FROM Orders · one table is enough. Placement, shipment and delivery dates belong to the same order. Keeping that row gives order 2 a place in the report even while its later dates are missing.
svg.text: Days to ship and days to deliver
If an order has no ship date yet, what happens to its row and its day count?

even while its later dates are missing.
